# RoboIntern: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 875dfdcdba1e · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Describe your data as a list of columns; RoboIntern ranks the right machine-learning models, explains the maths, and writes the Python to train and predict.
**Live:** https://robointern.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/RoboIntern · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/robointern/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py robointern` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Forms vs JS (2026-11-08 conversion):** Landing, Auth, Profile, Admin (+ Commons moderation tab), Notebook, Commons and Snippet are Forms. The Lab, the Atlas and the Casebook stay JavaScript screens (`theme/assets/ri-screens.js`, moved unchanged from web/pages) mounted by `Components/Screen`; the engine (Atlas + Casebook data, parser, recommender, code writer, KaTeX helpers) is `theme/assets/ri-engine.js`.
- **Bridge:** `client_code/ri.py` sets `window.RI_BRIDGE` (UI.api for the screens) and `RI.host` (toast, confirm, remember_after, save_listing, save_dataset, go). `theme/assets/ri-kit.js` is the old `window.UI` shim + `RI.py.*` JSON helpers (meta, caseTeaser, lemma, specView, generate, startSample, codeBlock). Python only gets JSON text, never JS objects.
- **The Lab's dialogs** are Python: `Dialogs/SaveListing`, `Dialogs/SaveDataset` (opened from ri-screens.js via `RI.host`). A listing's details: `Dialogs/EditDetails`.
- **Hand-offs** between pages use browser storage keys `robointern.lab`, `lab-load`, `lab-pick` (unchanged from the JS version, so drafts survive).
- **Screen pages** set `waits = True` (UI_READY comes from the screen). `state.set_me` also sets `UI.me` (the screens decide "save" vs "sign up first" from it).
- **Tests:** `tools/check.py` also runs `tools/testing/codegen/cases.js` (reads ri-engine.js). gen.js + run.py (codegen end to end) need an ML venv: see the guide.
- Design kit facelift: eyebrows folded into headings, the hero glow removed, theorem boxes are hairline + tint (no 3px side stripe), 12px text floor. Cream paper + graph grid are the user's chosen identity (design-ok).
- Leading spaces in form templates collapse: indented code in a template uses `&#160;`.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **datasets**: owner→users, name:str, columns:obj, settings:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Notebook
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **snippets**: owner→users, title:str, model:str, task:str, spec:obj, files:obj, notes:str, tags:obj, starred:bool, is_public:bool, cites:num, forked_from→snippets, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Commons, DemoData, Notebook
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
